description: This PHP source file defines the ViewSearchView class, which extends from ViewListView. It manages the display and AJAX interactions for the search view editor within the ModuleBuilder component of SuiteCRM, a CRM extension based on SugarCRM. It handles rendering the search view template, constructing breadcrumbs for navigation, and integrating with the parser factory for module-specific parsing.

classes.name: ViewSearchView
classes.description: A class extending the ViewListView to provide search view editing capabilities within ModuleBuilder, including rendering, AJAX navigation, and layout preview features.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ViewSearchView instance, setting the layout based on request parameters.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns the module title parameters, including the module name and title, for display in the UI.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Overridden to prevent loading a bean for a non-existent module before display.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the search view, either as a preview or full view, using Smarty templates and AJAX.

methods.name: constructAjax
methods.description: Builds the AJAX navigation breadcrumbs specific to the module or Studio context for the search view editor.
